note: Treats (P2h, docs/future/13 section 8; plan approved October 25, 2026). A treat is a pouch thing a species likes, set out from its pouch card: the nearest creature that likes it comes and eats it at once, the Feed pattern. What it earns is in each species' presence (treatFeeds meals of feedTrust, once a game day); which treats a species likes, and where, is its recipe's treat block. Read by src/world/creatures/treats.js and tools/trust-lab.html.
tossNote: A treat for a school in the water (its species' treat.water) is tossed on out along the same line, up to tossM from the walker, to the first water deep enough for that school to swim (its motion.minDepthM plus tossDeeperM): ponds shelve gently and you kneel at the edge.
setOutMNote: How far in front of the walker a treat is set down. First the walker turns setOutTurnDeg off the way the view looks (toward the side it already faces), so the treat lies beside the kneeling figure on the screen, not hidden behind it.
fadeNote: A treat nobody comes for lies where it was set, then pales over its last paleH game hours and is gone fadeH game hours after it was set: back into the ground. Saved with the island, so a reload and a catch-up agree.

coming.minnows: The minnows swirl up to it.
coming.turtles: A turtle has seen it. Watch the water.

waiting.frogs: A frog has seen it, but waits for you to back off.

words.none: Nothing comes for it. In time the ground will take it back.
words.edge: This wants the water's edge. Kneel on the bank, with the water close.

edgeNote: edge: what Set out says (and the treat stays in the pack) for a kind set at the water's edge (a species' treat.edge, the turtles') when there is no bank with water close enough around you.
wordsNote: What the island says after Set out (the pouch card's action for a kind some species likes, recipes/species/<id>.json treat.kinds; its label is pack.json words.setOut). coming and waiting, by species key, when one comes for it; none for anything else, the same line whoever might like it, so the card never tells you whose it is.

words.stood: You push the sticks into the soft bed. One stands bare above the water.
words.where: This wants the shallows of a pond. Kneel at the edge, with shallow fresh water in front of you.
words.full: Enough perches stand already. Take one up first.
words.name: Perch stick
words.line: A handful of sticks pushed into the pond bed, one standing bare above the water.
words.noRoom: No room in the pack for the sticks.
words.far: Can't reach it from here. Come to the edge beside it.

perchNote: The perch stick (B1 P1, docs/future/13 8.3 F-07, October 29, 2026; src/world/creatures/perch-sticks.js): once the dragonflies are found (after), the sticks pouch's card offers words.stand on foot. You kneel and push one handful of sticks into the bed aheadM in front (turned turnDeg into view, as a treat), or on out along that line up to wadeM, at the first fresh, still water between shallowM deep: a placed piece of kind 'perch', saved with the island. It stands aboveM above the water (more or less, by its seed), its foot sinkM into the bed, radiusM thick, leaning up to leanDeg, with one side twig (twig) and a darker wet foot (wetColor, linear albedo) under the waterline; tipShare of its top is the bare tip a dragonfly lands on. At most cap stand at once. Its card (a tap within tapM of its foot, or a tap whose ray passes within rayM of the stick itself) says its line, opens from the bank (cardReachM past a thing's usual reach, walker.json click.thingReachM, since you cannot wade out to it), and offers Take up within takeReachM on foot, which gives the handful of sticks back. Dragonflies on patrol rest on it now and then (dragonfly.json motion stickChance), and one landing while you are within the treat's nearM is their treat.
labHabitNote: The trust lab's keeper (docs/future/13 8.5): each played day (24 real minutes at normal speed) sits near the creature 6 real minutes (each counts watch.sitBoost), stands near it 4, and feeds it twice, at least fullH game hours apart. The game never reads this.
